scoring._note: Methodology v0.1 (prototype). Every weight and curve parameter here is a design choice to be justified and calibrated (master doc section 8.6), not validated science. Nutrient thresholds live in data/reference/thresholds.csv with sources.

subscore_curve._note: lower_better: value <= green_bound scores 100, falls linearly to amber_floor at red_bound, then to 0 at red_bound x zero_multiple. higher_better: 0 scores 0, rising linearly to 100 at green_bound.

ingredient_deductions._note: Points removed from 100 for each class present. Signals of processing and disclosure, not safety judgements.

transparency._note: Score = 100 x share of core fields present, minus points per generic or undisclosed declaration.

value_curve._note: Price per 100 g at the category median scores 50; half the median scores 100; twice the median or more scores 0 (linear in log2 ratio).

evidence_labels.declared: Stated on the product listing or package.
evidence_labels.derived: Calculated from declared data (for example sodium from salt, or per 100 g from per serving).
evidence_labels.interpreted: Judged against a defined benchmark or keyword rule (for example the category).
evidence_labels.verified: Checked against an authoritative source (the verified evaluation set).
evidence_labels.unknown: Cannot be established from available evidence. Shown as unknown, never as zero.

claim_statuses.consistent with available evidence: The declared values meet the FSSAI condition for this claim.
claim_statuses.requires context: The claim may be accurate but needs extra context or a qualifying statement.
claim_statuses.potential inconsistency for review: The declared values do not meet the recorded condition. This is a prompt for review, not an accusation.
claim_statuses.cannot be verified from available inform: A value or condition needed for the check is missing.

missing_data: Missing values stay unknown and are never treated as zero.
Nutrition needs at least 50% of its weighted nutrients; otherwise no overall score is given.
Dimensions that cannot be scored are left out and the remaining weights renormalised; the report says which.
freshness: Each product shows when it was collected; prices are stored as dated observations.

limitations: Methodology v0.1.0 is a prototype: weights and curves are design choices to be calibrated, not validated science.
Red (high) nutrient bounds use the UK FSA 2016 scheme as a labelled placeholder; FSSAI has no final 'high' cut-offs.
FSSAI front-of-pack warning thresholds are not published, so the warning simulation is not run.
Extraction accuracy has not been measured on a verified set yet; see notebooks/evaluation.ipynb for what is measured.
Barcode scanning, label OCR, cross-source validation, personalisation and lab evidence are future work.
The score is consumer decision support, not a medical or clinical assessment.
